name: Dumbbell Side-Lying Lateral Raise
steps: Lie on your side on the floor with legs stacked and a dumbbell in your top hand resting beside your thigh.
Brace your core and lift your top arm toward the ceiling with a soft bend in your elbow.
Pause briefly near vertical, then lower the dumbbell smoothly back to your thigh.
Complete the working arm, then turn over to repeat on the other side.
tips: Keep your shoulders and hips stacked vertically as your arm moves.
Guide the dumbbell back to your thigh without letting it drop through the bottom of the arc.
